rawRetro.summary: Implemented the personal to-do list (issue #365) as an application-owned feature: one `todos` table via an immutable migration, an idempotent three-row seed (one completed), a TodoService + provider exposing list/create/setCompleted, authenticated /api/todos GET/POST/PATCH routes, and a /todos page with add, toggle, loading/empty/error states, tested through the route, service, migration and seed. Added zh-CN/en-US copy and the navigation entry, and registered the page in the route-name grant test.

improvements.title: Seed context destructuring trips @typescript-eslint/unbound-method
improvements.detail: `defineSeed({ async run({ repository }) { ... } })` reads naturally and type-checks, but `SeedContext.repository` is declared as a method, so destructuring it makes eslint's `@typescript-eslint/unbound-method` fail the repository's `--max-warnings 0` lint. The seed must keep the context object and call `context.repository(...)`.
improvements.suggestedChange: Add one line and the correct snippet to the migrations/seeds reference showing `async run(context)` with `const repository = context.repository('collection')`, or declare `repository` as a readonly function property on `SeedContext` so destructuring is safe.

improvements.title: Logical camelCase field names map to snake_case physical columns
improvements.detail: A Collection field declared as `createdAt` is stored physically as `created_at`. The Repository returns the logical name, so application code is unaffected, but a raw SQL check against the database (as in manual verification) fails unless the physical name is used. This is easy to mistake for a broken migration.
improvements.suggestedChange: State the logical-to-physical naming mapping explicitly in the database-and-data reference, including how to inspect physical columns when verifying a migration by hand.

buildReview.reason: 独立 Agent 评审完成；评分是基于本次证据的意见，不替代业务 QA 或人工评审。

evaluation.summary: 本场景中框架能力总体被正确使用并直接支撑需求：@nocobase/db 的迁移/种子/Repository、@nocobase/service-provider 的 token 注入、@nocobase/app-server 的路由装配与 app-plugin-authentication 的 auth.required()、@nocobase/app-client 的 useApiClient/ApiClientError 以及 @nocobase/i18n 的中英文文案机制，工厂 B01–B04 全部通过。最明确的框架问题是 nocobase-db Skill 的种子示例直接解构 SeedContext.repository（方法属性），照抄即触发 @typescript-eslint/unbound-method，Agent 需额外诊断并改写；其次是“新页面一律走 full workflow”与“工厂流水线已负责验收”两套要求缺少消歧。覆盖限制：评审模型不支持图像输入，未做跨页面视觉评审；Agent 历史 coverage=partial，仅存分块文本；包为编译产物，可靠性结论基于 dist/.js 实现。

modules.name: 数据库 schema、迁移、种子与仓储（@nocobase/db）

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md
entrypoints: §2 迁移与种子的不可变/幂等规则

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/migrations.md
entrypoints: pnpm nocobase db apply 的执行顺序

modules.scope: todos 单表的 schema 声明、迁移与种子执行、运行时 Repository 读写，以及应用侧幂等种子的写法。
modules.limitations: 未覆盖关系字段、显式事务、QueryAdapter、其它方言；种子的 title 幂等键未建唯一约束（应用选择），未在此验证。

requirements.need: 建立一张 todos 表（自增 id、title 必填且长度 255、completed 默认 false、createdAt），并能新增、列出、更新记录。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责 schema DSL、迁移执行与通用 Repository 读写；应用负责具体字段、空标题业务规则与完成状态语义。
requirements.recommendedUsage: defineMigration + builder.createCollection(...) 声明字段，defineSeed + context.repository('todos') 写安装数据，运行时用 database.repository('todos')。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 按此实现 migration（builder.createCollection + increments/string/boolean/datetime）、seed 与 service，字段与需求一致，未绕过 Repository。

requirements.need: 迁移与种子在真实数据库上执行且可重复运行（幂等）。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责迁移/种子历史、锁、校验和与默认事务；应用负责种子内容的幂等键。
requirements.recommendedUsage: migration 自包含、不可变；seed 幂等，Skill 推荐 upsertOne，或以稳定业务键判断存在性。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 用 defineSeed + exists(title) 再 createOne 实现幂等，可重复执行；未按 Skill 的 upsertOne 示例，也未给 title 建唯一约束。

requirements.need: 运行时统一的数据访问层，读写 todos 并把记录不存在映射为业务错误。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责 Repository 的类型化读写与错误语义；应用负责字段映射与过滤条件。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 在 service 中封装 todos().createOne/updateOne/findMany，捕获 RepositoryError 且仅对 RECORD_NOT_FOUND 返回 undefined。

requirementFit.reason: defineMigration/defineSeed/Repository 直接覆盖本场景的单表 CRUD、安装数据与不存在语义，迁移和种子实际执行成功；扣分点是 createdAt 无 timestamps 辅助、需应用手写。

usability.reason: builder 链式字段与 repository 方法调用直观，公开入口在 database-and-data.md 中给了默认选择，Agent 一次写对主要结构。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 种子示例 async run({ repository }) 与 SeedContext.repository 的实际方法属性不符，照抄即触发 lint error；camelCase 到物理 snake_case 的列名也只说由 underscored 决定，Agent 需试错才能确认。

design.reason: migration、seed、runtime 三种上下文分离，seed 上下文不含 builder，Repository 与 Query 的职责按集合记录/非集合结果集划分清晰。

reliability.reason: Seeder 默认在事务内运行并维护锁与校验和历史；Repository 在写入前做 policy/metadata 校验，并把缺失记录稳定映射为 RECORD_NOT_FOUND。

modules.name: 业务 service 的注册与依赖注入（@nocobase/service-provider）
modules.scope: 把 todos 业务逻辑做成可注入 service，并以 token 在路由处解析，避免路由直接 import 实现。
modules.limitations: 未覆盖 provider 生命周期钩子（boot/start/ready）、instance 绑定与客户端容器。

requirements.need: todos 业务逻辑由容器注入，路由按 token 获取 service。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责容器、token 与 provider 装配；应用负责 service 实现、业务规则与注册入口。
requirements.recommendedUsage: createServiceToken + extends ServiceProvider + container.singleton(token, factory)，并在 server/providers/index.ts 汇总注册。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 在 server/providers/todo.ts 定义 todoServiceToken 与 TodoProvider，index.ts 导出，路由 resolve(todoServiceToken)。

requirements.need: service 依赖数据库而不 new 出实现，token 不得重复创建。
requirements.responsibility: 框架按对象身份匹配 token 并保证单例；应用集中导出 token。
requirements.recommendedUsage: provider 内 resolve(databaseManagerToken)；token 从定义处 import。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 在 provider 工厂内 resolve(databaseManagerToken)，路由 import 同一个 todoServiceToken。

requirementFit.reason: createServiceToken/ServiceProvider/singleton 直接满足业务 service 的注册与解析需求，应用代码与指引示例结构一致。

usability.reason: 注册与解析步骤少且明确，指引给出完整可套用示例并说明 token 身份语义。

agentFriendliness.reason: 指引明确 service 该放哪、何时抽 service、provider 如何汇总注册，Agent 无需自创装配方式。

design.reason: 容器/registry/provider/token 职责分离，单例按需创建，token 以对象身份而非字符串匹配，扩展点清晰。

reliability.reason: 容器对重复注册、缺失服务、循环依赖和构造失败都有稳定错误，并缓存失败避免重复构造。

modules.name: 服务端 HTTP 路由装配与鉴权
modules.scope: 服务端 /todos 路由的装配、/api 前缀、逐路由鉴权与错误到 HTTP 状态码的映射。
modules.limitations: 未覆盖 authorization/权限、root 路由、请求体 schema 校验与中间件顺序的完整语义。

requirements.need: 暴露列表/新增/更新完成状态的 HTTP 接口，浏览器经 /api 调用。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责路由注册、/api 前缀与 Hono 集成；应用负责端点设计、请求校验与状态码。
requirements.recommendedUsage: defineApiRoutes(app => new Hono()...) + context.json，路径不写 /api。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 在 server/routes/todos.ts 用 defineApiRoutes + Hono，路径 /todos，返回 { data }。

requirements.need: 接口要求登录，未登录返回 401。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 auth.required() 与 401 语义；应用负责在每条路由上挂载。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在路由或路由器上安装 auth.required()。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 为每条路由安装 requireAuth = auth.required()，与指引“每路由自持安全”一致。

requirementFit.reason: defineApiRoutes 与 authenticationToken/auth.required() 直接支撑带鉴权的 REST 端点，QA 中新增与完成切换通过。

usability.reason: 路由工厂内 resolve 依赖、Hono context.json 返回、/api 前缀由运行时添加，接入步骤少且指引有完整示例。

agentFriendliness.reason: server-routes.md 明确两种路由、路径规则和“每路由自持安全”，并解释为何不能依赖他人中间件，Agent 未误用。

design.reason: 路由器作为服务暴露、api/root 作用域分离、鉴权与授权分层，公开扩展点清晰。

reliability.reason: auth.required() 在无会话时稳定返回 401，并透传 Better Auth 的 APIError 状态，错误路径可预期。

modules.name: 客户端路由、页面装配与 API 客户端

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/frontend/references/api.md
entrypoints: 必须用应用 HTTP 客户端，禁止 fetch/axios 与硬编码 /api

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/frontend/ui-workflow.md
entrypoints: Full workflow（design + design review + acceptance review）

modules.scope: 客户端路由/导航声明、页面装配、统一 HTTP 客户端调用与错误处理，以及新页面的前端工作流判定。
modules.limitations: 未覆盖 child routes/dialog/drawer 与 authz 的完整权限语义；本次未做视觉评审，样式一致性未评价。

requirements.need: 声明 /todos 路由与导航项（翻译键、图标），页面懒加载。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责路由注册、导航与懒加载；应用负责路由名、路径与页面组件。

evidence.excerpt:
The rules are absolute, because these files are history that has already run on other machines:

- **Self-contained.** Spell out every table, field, index, constraint and metadata operation in the file. Never import a Collection definition, model, registry or shared constant that keeps evolving — that silently changes both the behavior and the checksum of something already applied.
- **Immutable once merged.** Check with `git log -- <file>` if unsure. Before the branch is merged you may correct the file in place; after it, every change is a new, later file. Never hard-code a previous checksum to make an edited migration look untouched. Correcting it in place changes nothing on its own — it is recorded as executed, so a plain apply skips it and the database keeps the schema the old file produced. `pnpm nocobase db redo` rolls the latest batch back and applies it again.
- **The file name body matches `name`**, and the name is unique across every source in the application.
- **Declare `irreversible: true`** when there is no real reverse operation, instead of writing a `down()` that quietly does nothing.
- **A seed is idempotent**, keyed on a stable business value backed by a unique constraint, so a repeated run is a no-op — `upsertOne` is the direct way to express that. A seed context has no `builder` at all, and a seed has no rollback or truncate behavior.

A backfill belongs in the migration that makes it necessary, using `query` from the same context — not in a seed.

Both run inside a transaction by default. `transaction: false` opts out, and a failure then leaves partial work behind with no history record, so take it only when the operation genuinely cannot run in one.

evidence.observation: 解析 databaseManagerToken；database.repository(collection) 是集合记录默认入口，query 用于非集合结果集。
evidence.excerpt:
Resolve `databaseManagerToken` from the container:

```ts
import { databaseManagerToken } from '@nocobase/db';

const database = app.container.resolve(databaseManagerToken);
```

In a route factory, resolve it once in the factory rather than inside each handler. In a service, take it as a constructor dependency — see [services and jobs](services-and-jobs.md).

From there, `database.repository(collection)` is the default for a collection's records and their relations, `database.query()` is for a result set that is not any collection's records, and `database.transaction(fn)` groups writes that must succeed or fail together. Each takes an optional connection name and uses the default connection when omitted.

evidence.observation: migrations/seeds 目录约定与 db apply 执行顺序；种子内容需固定可复现。
evidence.excerpt:
# Migrations and seeds

This page is the application side: where the directories live, how `pnpm nocobase db apply` runs them, how additional connections configure their tasks, and what to do about checksum drift and compiled manifests.

How to write the files themselves — the migration and seed shape, the immutability and self-containment rules, the Collection Builder, and which of `builder`, `query` and `repository` a task context should reach for — belongs to the package that owns them. Read `.agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md` sections 2 and 3 before writing one, and run `pnpm nocobase skills sync` if that file is missing.

Migrations under `database/main/migrations/` are the application's schema history. Seeds under `database/main/seeds/` insert records the application requires to run. Migrations create structure. Seeds never do.

`database/tsconfig.json` extends the server configuration so editor tooling and ESLint recognize migrations and seeds as Node source. Keep it in place when adding connection directories.

## Running

```bash
pnpm nocobase db apply
```

This applies pending migrations and then pending seeds for `database.default`, including registered plugins, ordered by name across all sources. Both halves run only what is pending, so on an already-migrated database it applies seeds alone. The template defaults to `main`. Plugin migrations, seeds and runtime default reads/writes always use this same connection; changing `database.default` changes the application system database.

Seeds are the second half of that run, so the structure a seed writes into must already exist from an earlier migration. Keep seed data fixed and reproducible — no current timestamps or random values in identifying fields — and never let a repeat run silently overwrite data a user has edited.

evidence.excerpt:
## 1. Declare the route

Append an entry to the end of the existing `defineAppRoutes([...])` array in `client/routes.ts`. Leave the existing routes (home, sign-in pages) as they are, and do not overwrite the whole file. Add the icon to the existing `lucide-react` import at the top of the file:

```ts
import { FolderKanban, Home } from 'lucide-react';
```

The projects list page to append, with three child routes for create, detail and edit:

```ts
const appRoutes: AppClientRouteContribution = defineAppRoutes([
  // … existing routes (home, sign-in pages); keep them
  {
    name: 'projects',
    path: '/projects',
    auth: 'required',
    authz: 'skip',
    navigation: { title: 'navigation.projects', icon: FolderKanban },
    componentLoader: () => import('./pages/projects/index.js'),
    children: [
      {
        // /projects/new: create dialog (RouteDialog)
        name: 'project-new',
        path: 'new',
        authz: 'skip',
        componentLoader: () => import('./pages/projects/new.js'),
      },
      {
        // /projects/:projectId: detail drawer (RouteDrawer)
        name: 'project-detail',
        path: ':projectId',
        authz: 'skip',
        componentLoader: () => import('./pages/projects/detail/index.js'),
        children: [
          {
            // /projects/:projectId/edit: edit dialog, stacked on the detail drawer
            name: 'project-edit',
            path: 'edit',
            authz: 'skip',
            componentLoader: () => import('./pages/projects/detail/edit.js'),
          },
        ],
      },
    ],
  },
]);
```

| Field             | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `name`            | Route name. Only letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-` are allowed; kebab-case is recommended. Unique among the application's App routes. It is the target of route overrides, so do not change it after release |
| `path`            | A root route starts with `/`; a child route is one segment relative to its parent (`new`, `:projectId`). It cannot contain query parameters, `#`, `*` or `..`                                                |
| `auth`            | Who can open the page; see section 3. Defaults to `'required'`                                                                                                                                               |
| `authz`           | Page authorization; declare it on the first page of every path, nested pages inherit it; see section 4                                                                                                       |
| `navigation`      | Menu entry: `title` (translation key), `icon`, `order`; see section 6. Omit it when the page needs no menu entry                                                                                             |
| `breadcrumb`      | Breadcrumb title (translation key); see section 7                                                                                                                                                            |
| `componentLoader` | Lazily loads the page module; the module must `export default` the page component                                                                                                                            |
| `children`        | Child routes; see `child-routes.md`                                                                                                                                                                          |

Rules:

- **Keep `componentLoader` lazy**. Route information is declared synchronously, so the router can resolve navigation without downloading every page; page code is downloaded only when the page is visited.
- **Write import paths with the `.js` extension**, even when the source file is `.tsx`. This is how this project resolves modules, not a typo.
- **Paths are internal to the application**: do not write the deployment base path `/main`. The application is mounted under a base path (`/main` by default), and the runtime adds it automatically: `/projects` is `/main/projects` in the browser.
- **Reserved paths**: `/login`, `/register`, `/forgot-password` and `/reset-password` can only use `auth: 'guest'`. They are already declared in `client/routes.ts`, and their pages are in `client/pages/auth/`.
- App routes share one path space with settings pages and dev pages: do not declare an App route that starts with `/settings` or `/dev`, or it will conflict with them.

evidence.observation: 必须用应用 HTTP 客户端，禁止 fetch/axios 与硬编码 /api；从 @nocobase/app-client 导入 useApiClient/ApiClientError。
evidence.excerpt:
Every endpoint request goes through the HTTP client the application provides:

- **Do not** create your own client, do not use `fetch` or axios, do not hard-code `/api`, and do not build endpoint URLs from `location`. The client's `api.baseURL` already includes the deployment base path (for example `/main`).
- Import `useApiClient`, `apiClientToken`, the `ApiClient` type and `ApiClientError` from `@nocobase/app-client`. That way the application and plugins share one runtime and one error class, which is what makes `instanceof ApiClientError` reliable.

evidence.observation: ApiClientError 字段与按 404/403/业务码/其它分别处理，且不向前端用户展示后端 message。
evidence.excerpt:
### ApiClientError

When the response is not 2xx, `api.request` throws `ApiClientError`:

| Field           | Contents                                                                                       |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `status`        | The HTTP status code                                                                           |
| `code`          | The business error code, taken from `error.code` or `code` in the response body; may be absent |
| `payload`       | The complete parsed response body, typed `unknown`                                             |
| `requestId`     | The `x-request-id` response header, for matching the error with server logs; may be absent     |
| `method`, `url` | The request method and full URL                                                                |
| `message`       | Taken from the error message the backend returned; **do not show it to users**                 |

- Network errors (offline, server unreachable) and cancellations do not throw `ApiClientError`; they throw fetch's own errors. In `catch`, write `error: unknown`, narrow it with `error instanceof ApiClientError` first, and only then read these fields.
- Handle only the errors you can handle; rethrow the rest for the caller.

### Handling each kind of error

Write the checks directly in the component that uses them (for example `ProjectSummary` above and `CompleteProjectButton` below); do not create an application-wide utility function for this.

| Case                       | Check                                                                    | Handling                                                                                                                                                    |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Record not found           | `error instanceof ApiClientError && error.status === 404`                | Say the record does not exist or has been deleted, offer a next step (close the overlay, go back to the list) and refresh the list; no retry (guideline R3) |
| No permission              | `error instanceof ApiClientError && error.status === 403`                | Say the user does not have permission; no retry (guideline S4)                                                                                              |
| Business error code        | `error instanceof ApiClientError && error.code === 'PROJECT_NAME_TAKEN'` | Show it below the matching field with `form.setError(...)`; see `form.md`                                                                                   |
| Other (network, 5xx, etc.) | None of the above                                                        | Say "The request failed. Please try again."; when loading data, offer "Retry"                                                                               |

- **Do not show raw messages from the backend**: the text in `error.message` and `payload` may be an English exception, a stack trace or SQL, and must not appear in the UI (guideline I3).
- Error copy goes in the feature's own copy group, for example `projects.error.notFound`, `projects.error.forbidden` and `projects.error.requestFailed`, in both Chinese and English (see `i18n.md`).

evidence.observation: workflow 选择表：任一为“新页面”即属 full workflow（design + design review + acceptance review）。
evidence.excerpt:
## Choosing a workflow

Decide before you start, and say in one sentence in your reply which workflow you are following and why.

| Workflow      | When it applies                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Full workflow | Any one of: a new page; a new complete interaction (a create/edit flow, a detail drawer, a multi-step operation); a change to the page structure or main interactions; one change that touches the UI of several pages; the user asks to see the design first |
| Quick change  | None of the above applies. For example: changing copy; adjusting styling details; adding a button, a column, a form field or a filter to an existing page; fixing a UI bug; a refactor that changes neither appearance nor behavior                           |

When unsure, explain the difference in one sentence (the full workflow adds a design, a design review and an independent acceptance review) and let the user choose.

## Quick change

1. Read `frontend-dev.md` and the references under `references/` related to the change. When the change affects how the interface looks or behaves, also read the relevant guidelines in `ui-guidelines.md`, and at minimum check the relevant items of the "Review checklist" at its end.
2. Follow how the page is already written: keep components, spacing and copy style consistent with what surrounds the change.
3. Run static checks on the changed files only: `pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit`, `pnpm exec eslint --max-warnings 0 <files>`, `pnpm exec prettier --check <files>`.
4. Report what you changed and which checks you ran.

A quick change does not test in a browser, run test cases, write a design file or a run record, or start a reviewer subagent. Five steps: design → design review → development → acceptance review → report. The design review and the acceptance review each happen once; there is no loop.

All text a user can see goes through a translation key: titles, buttons, column headers, placeholders, `aria-label`, toasts and validation messages all count. Text hard-coded in a component cannot be translated, and changing its wording means changing code.

For the wording itself (which verb a button uses, how to write empty states and errors, how to put record names in quotes), see section C of `../ui-guidelines.md`; this document covers only how to write the code.

## Where copy lives

| File                      | Purpose                                                                                     |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `client/locales/en-US.ts` | English; also defines the structure of the copy and exports the type `AppResource`          |
| `client/locales/zh-CN.ts` | Chinese; typed as `AppResource`, so its structure must match the English                    |
| `client/locales/index.ts` | One dynamic `import()` per language, so the browser downloads only the language being shown |

Rules:

- Each new feature gets its own group (`projects: { … }`), which holds all of the feature's copy.
- Add menu titles to the existing `navigation` group (`navigation.projects`), and write `navigation: { title: 'navigation.projects' }` in the route (see `page.md`).
- Add the key to `en-US.ts` first, then add the same key to `zh-CN.ts`. A key missing from `zh-CN.ts` or extra in it (including a misspelled one) fails type checking.
- **Keys passed to `t()` are not type-checked.** `t('projects.titel')` compiles, and the page shows `projects.titel` as is. So always look at the page in both languages (see "Checks").
- When you copy structure from the reference pages (`client/pages/reference/`), move the copy into the feature's own group in `client/locales/`. The reference pages' copy is in `client/pages/reference/locales/`; it is not part of the build, so do not reference it.

evidence.excerpt:
### User-facing text

Every string a user reads goes through a translation key. `client/locales/en-US.ts` states the wording and derives the shape that other locales are checked against, so a missing key in `zh-CN.ts` is a compile error.

```tsx
const { t } = useTranslation();
t('orders.title');
```

To reword a plugin's string, add an `overrides` block keyed by that plugin's package name in your locale file. Do not edit the plugin.

The languages the application offers are its own locale files, not a configured list, and the two sides are read separately: `client/locales/` decides what the picker shows, while `server/locales/` decides which languages the server can answer in. Prefer adding a language to both when server-produced text needs translating, but a client-only language is valid: the interface switches normally and the server falls back to English with an informational notice. `pnpm nocobase locales check` reports one declared on a single side and exits nonzero until the lists align; that check does not block the runtime switch.

The account menu language control in `client/layouts/components/language-switcher.tsx` uses a shadcn submenu with radio items. Render it inside `DropdownMenuContent` to preserve menu keyboard navigation and selection semantics.
